LESSON: PUBLIC FINANCE

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: BUSINESS STUDIES
Strand: Government and Global Influence in Business
Topic 3.1: Public Finance
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 12

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Public Finance, part of Government and Global Influence in Business in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10 BUSINESS STUDIES.

Key inquiry question: how does taxation impact economic development?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Public Finance together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Self-efficacy: learner develops effective communication skills when brainstorming and presenting on the meaning

and importance of taxation.

36

● Critical thinking and problem solving: learner enhances research skills when analysing case studies on ethical

issues in taxation.

● Creativity and imagination: learner strengthens networking skills when writing an article on the importance of

taxation in Kenya.

● Digital literacy: learner enhances the skills of interacting and connecting with digital technology when using digital

devices with assistive technology to search for information on the trends in taxation in Kenya.

Values:
● Patriotism: learner shows loyalty to the country when brainstorming and presenting on the meaning and

importance of taxation.

● Integrity: learner shows accountability when sharing the requirements for tax compliance.

● Love: learner respects others opinions when brainstorming and presenting on the meaning and importance of

taxation.

● Social justice: learner fosters inclusivity and non-discrimination when discussing the principles of taxation.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs)

● Peer Education and Mentorship: learner enhances interpersonal relationships when brainstorming and presenting

on the meaning and importance of taxation.

● Financial Literacy: learner enhances tax literacy skills when brainstorming and presenting on the meaning and

importance of taxation.

● Internet Safety and Security: responsible online behaviour is enhanced as a learner uses digital devices with

assistive technology to search and share information on the trends in taxation in Kenya.

● Mental Health: emotional awareness is enhanced as a learner relates well with peers when discussing and sharing

the requirements for tax compliance in Kenya.

Suggested Learning Resources

● Business Studies curriculum design

● Business Studies handbook

● Digital device with assistive technology.

● Volunteer resource person

37

● Approved textbooks and reference materials

● Photographs and pictures

● Charts and tactile charts
